correctness.rationale: The bijection between total dominating Petersen vertex subsets and complementary triangle-free five-vertex graphs follows from the equivalence of two-vertex covers and independent triples. Single-vertex moves become one-edge toggles exactly. The two included, independent standard-library verifiers enumerate every one of 1024 bitmasks and every valid transition, independently reconstruct the 332-state graph, calculate all 54,946 unordered pair distances by BFS, verify all ten automorphism orbits, and confirm the sharp connectivity cap; one searches Petersen total dominating sets directly, the other uses forbidden triangle masks. Induction on BFS depth proves the exact finite certificate; no nonenumerated cases are claimed.

value.rationale: The Petersen graph is a canonical ten-vertex cubic test case for reconfiguration. The sharp first connected cardinality cap, exact center/periphery, six antipodal configurations pairs, and precisely classified geodesic overhead are meaningful intrinsic invariants of shortest reconfiguration pathways. The triangle-free complement supplies a structural bridge to constrained graph edit metrics, and the data are an exact benchmark for path-finding and reconfiguration theory rather than arbitrary slices of a large table.
